title: Thirteen Winters and One Short Hedge
subtitle: 农业生产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 农业生产（人与自然·自然与地理）
meta: 主题语境：农业生产（人与自然·自然与地理）　|　核心词汇：farm　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 farm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1943 my grandfather ① ran a farm that no neighbour in the valley would have measured, and he said the running was the whole of the winter. The ② farm, meaning the land itself and not the house, ran thirteen winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; a farm, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ farm in that valley had the same short hedge beside it, and the ④ farm at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the sheep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A farm, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; my grandfather said the measuring is the part that fills thirteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the farm was the whole of the work, meaning the holding and not the land. The ⑥ farm, meaning the holding and not any of that, is the only thing in a piece of work that everybody waits for and nobody measures; farm, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both land and a holding. He said the holding is the part they remember.

By 1952 the ⑦ farm had become a line in a deed, and the deed had become an argument about the short hedge. The ⑧ farm of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one valley and thirteen winters of measuring; farm, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ farm I remember is the one measured in the deed, which closed in 1956 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ farm, my mother said in 1958, is the only one that improves by being measured; every farm, she said, is a holding that has agreed to look like a piece of land. She said the holding was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 农场（指山谷里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 农场（指那片田地本身，与农舍相对）
C. 固定搭配：run a farm 经营一座农场
D. n. 农场（指留给羊群的那一座）
E. n. 农场（抽象总称，指一条山谷的务农之事）
F. n. 农场（指契约上写到、被丈量的那一座）
G. n. 农庄；产业（指一份活计里人人都等却无人丈量的那样东西）
H. n. 产业（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人丈量的那样东西）

items.q: ran a farm that no neighbour in the valley would have measured
The farm, meaning the land itself and not the house
the farm at the far side
the farm was the whole of the work
the farm had become a line in a deed
The farm of the whole thing
A farm, my mother said in 1958

answers.why: run a farm 意为“经营一座农场”，1943 年祖父经营了一座山谷里没有一位邻居肯丈量的农场。
farm 意为“农场”，指那片田地本身而不是农舍，它经过了十三个冬天而在簿子上没有尺寸。
farm 意为“农场”，指山谷里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一道短短的树篱。
farm 意为“农场”，指留给羊群的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
farm 意为“农庄、产业”，指一份活计里人人都等却无人丈量的那样东西，叔叔说这份产业就是那份活计的全部。
farm 意为“产业”，指人人都等却无人丈量的那样东西而不是那片田地，是活计里人人都等、却无人丈量的东西。
farm 意为“农场”，指契约上写到、被丈量的那一座，到 1952 年这一座成了契约里的一行。
farm 意为“农场”，祖父一月写道，整件事的务农之事是一条山谷和十三个冬天的丈量。
farm 意为“农场”，我记得的是契约上丈量的那一座，1956 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一座。
farm 为抽象总称，母亲 1958 年说，一座农场是唯一会因为被好好丈量而变得更好的东西。
